# Load the data
data = """survived,pclass,sex,age,sibsp,parch,fare,embarked,class,who,adult_male,deck,embark_town,alive,alone
0,3,male,22.0,1,0,7.25,S,Third,man,True,,Southampton,no,False
1,1,female,38.0,1,0,71.2833,C,First,woman,False,C,Cherbourg,yes,False
1,3,female,26.0,0,0,7.925,S,Third,woman,False,,Southampton,yes,True

df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(data))

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(12, 10))
fig.suptitle('Titanic Dataset Analysis', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# Plot 1: Survival by Sex
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
survival_by_sex = df.groupby(['sex', 'survived']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
survival_by_sex.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, color=['#ff6b6b', '#4ecdc4'])
ax1.set_title('Survival by Sex')
ax1.set_xlabel('Sex')
ax1.set_ylabel('Count')
ax1.legend(['Did not survive', 'Survived'], loc='upper right')
ax1.set_xticklabels(ax1.get_xticklabels(), rotation=0)

# Plot 2: Survival by Class
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
survival_by_class = df.groupby(['class', 'survived']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
survival_by_class.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax2, color=['#ff6b6b', '#4ecdc4'])
ax2.set_title('Survival by Passenger Class')
ax2.set_xlabel('Class')
ax2.set_ylabel('Count')
ax2.legend(['Did not survive', 'Survived'], loc='upper right')
ax2.set_xticklabels(ax2.get_xticklabels(), rotation=0)

# Plot 3: Age Distribution by Survival
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
colors = ['#ff6b6b', '#4ecdc4']
for i, survived in enumerate([0, 1]):
    subset = df[df['survived'] == survived]['age'].dropna()
    label = 'Survived' if survived == 1 else 'Did not survive'
    ax3.hist(subset, bins=10, alpha=0.7, label=label, color=colors[i])
ax3.set_title('Age Distribution by Survival')
ax3.set_xlabel('Age')
ax3.set_ylabel('Count')
ax3.legend()

# Plot 4: Fare vs Age colored by Survival
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
scatter_colors = df['survived'].map({0: '#ff6b6b', 1: '#4ecdc4'})
ax4.scatter(df['age'], df['fare'], c=scatter_colors, alpha=0.7, s=100, edgecolors='black')
ax4.set_title('Fare vs Age (colored by Survival)')
ax4.set_xlabel('Age')
ax4.set_ylabel('Fare')

legend_elements = [Patch(facecolor='#ff6b6b', label='Did not survive'),
